label: Conditional (бы)
description: A 20-question check on the conditional/subjunctive (бы) lessons.

questions.prompt: In standard conditional sentences, the particle бы always pairs with a verb in which form?
questions.explain: The lessons hammer that бы always combines with a past-tense verb form, as in «Если бы я знал, я бы тебе сказал».

questions.prompt: What is бы grammatically?
questions.explain: The lessons state бы is a mood particle, not a tense, so the past verbs it joins signal irrealis rather than past time.

questions.prompt: «Если бы я знал, я бы тебе сказал.» What does this sentence express?
options: A polite request to be told something
An unreal (counterfactual) situation: he did not know, so nothing was said
A completed action in the past
questions.explain: It is a full unreal conditional; both clauses use a past form with бы, marking the whole situation as counterfactual.

questions.prompt: «Если бы было время, мы бы погуляли.» Why are было and погуляли in the past form?
options: Because the walk actually happened yesterday
Because бы always combines with a past-tense verb form, even when the meaning is timeless
Because было is a noun here
Because the sentence describes a habit
questions.explain: The walk did not happen; the past forms are required by бы even though the meaning is timeless.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct unreal conditional: «Если бы ты позвонил, я бы ___.»
questions.explain: The result clause needs a past form with бы; «Если бы ты позвонил, я бы пришла» pairs two past verbs.

questions.prompt: «Я бы с радостью поехал с вами.» What kind of statement is this?
options: A statement that the speaker went with them
A standalone 'would' statement (would gladly go) with no spoken if-clause
A question about a past trip
questions.explain: бы plus past поехал means 'would go'; it is a result clause with the if-clause left unspoken.

questions.prompt: In «Было бы здорово увидеть тебя», what does было бы mean?
questions.explain: Было is the neuter past of быть and бы makes it hypothetical, so было бы means 'it would be'.

questions.prompt: Which frame is the polite-request 'Could you...?' construction?
questions.explain: Не могли бы вы + infinitive is the core polite request; the past могли with бы turns a command into a courteous question.

questions.prompt: In «Не могли бы вы повторить вопрос?», what does the conditional мood add?
options: Certainty — it is a firm command
Doubt about whether the person exists
Politeness — it softens a demand into a courteous question
questions.explain: The lessons note бы here pairs with the past могли to build the conditional mood and make the request sound polite.

questions.prompt: A male speaker says «Я хотел бы заказать чашку кофе.» A female speaker would say:
options: Я хотел бы заказать чашку кофе.
Я хотела бы заказать чашку кофе.
Я хочу бы заказать чашку кофе.
Я буду бы заказать чашку кофе.
questions.explain: бы pairs with a past form that agrees in gender, so a female speaker uses хотела, as in «Я хотела бы задать один вопрос».

questions.prompt: «Я хотел бы немного отдохнуть» is softer than which blunt alternative?
questions.explain: The lessons contrast the polite past хотел + бы with the flat present 'я хочу отдохнуть'.

questions.prompt: «Мне хотелось бы услышать ваше мнение.» What is special about this impersonal frame?
options: It is a direct order to give an opinion
The experiencer is in the dative (мне) and хотелось stays neuter — the wish feels gently felt rather than willed
мне is the grammatical subject in the nominative
questions.explain: The dative мне marks the experiencer while the neuter impersonal хотелось carries бы, softening the wish.

questions.prompt: «Скорее бы наступило лето.» Even though it is about the future, why is наступило past?
options: Because бы always pairs with a past-tense verb, regardless of meaning
questions.explain: The lessons stress that even about the future, бы pairs with a past form — here наступило — to voice an impatient wish.

questions.prompt: «Лучше бы мы остались дома.» What does this express?
options: A firm decision to stay home tonight
A preference with mild regret — staying home would have been better
A polite request to be allowed to leave
A simple statement that they stayed home
questions.explain: бы pairs with past остались to wish things had gone otherwise; Лучше marks staying home as the preferable choice.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is advice meaning 'if I were you, I would...'?
options: «На твоём месте я бы согласился сразу.»
questions.explain: На твоём месте я бы + past is the core advice frame: the speaker imagines standing in the listener's position.

questions.prompt: «Тебе бы отдохнуть пару дней.» Unlike most бы-frames, what verb form does this dative advice frame use?
questions.explain: In this dative-experiencer impersonal frame, бы joins the infinitive (тебе бы + inf), not a past form — meaning 'you ought to rest'.

questions.prompt: «Ты бы позвонил маме вечером.» What does this frame express?
options: A strict command to call now
A soft suggestion / nudge ('you might want to call')
A statement that he called mom
A question asking whether he called
questions.explain: Ты бы + past позвонил proposes the call lightly as a gentle nudge rather than an order.

questions.prompt: Fill in the advice frame: «На вашем месте я бы ___ договор.» (rereading the contract)
questions.explain: The на месте frame uses a past form with бы; «На вашем месте я бы перечитал договор» supplies the past перечитал.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a polite request, NOT a hypothetical or advice?
options: «Если бы они приехали, мы бы их встретили.»
«На твоём месте я бы взяла отпуск.»
questions.explain: Не могли бы вы + infinitive is a polite request; the others are an unreal conditional and two pieces of advice.

questions.prompt: «Если бы ты меня слушал, ты бы понял.» What does this counterfactual imply about reality?
options: The listening did not happen, so the understanding did not either
He will listen and then understand
He is being ordered to listen
questions.explain: It is a reproach as unreal conditional: слушал and понял are both past + бы, so neither event actually happened.
